entities.name: Compile and independently execute baseline kernel bytecode
entities.summary: Compile checked agent-facing kernel bytes into opaque finite process-local custody and execute them with an independent VM, using exact semantic.kernel-run observations for differential evidence against the reference interpreter.

acceptance: Reference and compiled paths share one strict bytes/check preparation boundary
Opaque immutable compiled custody contains a finite instruction/block graph
The independent VM never imports or calls the reference machine or interpreter
Every conclusive generated valid and deliberate-invalid case agrees as exact canonical kernel-run bytes
The explicit comparator inspects nested observation tags and equal fuel or trace inconclusives never agree
Valid generation covers every semantically admissible constructor and grade; raw resumption is invalid-only
Source-free custody retains no AST node or derivation and internal opcode, branch, and slot perturbations are detected
Bytecode remains process-local and carries no durable or cross-value dependency authority

relations.summary: The accepted reference interpreter supplies the independent semantic oracle and canonical run observation.
Both execution paths consume the same strict agent-facing bytes and check boundary.
The baseline compiler and independent VM establish an executable compiler backend without optimization or durable bytecode identity.
